About the Program
Our GLP-1 program supports patients on GLP-1 for weight management. Most GLP-1 patients in the Philippines are injecting with very little nutrition support — that gap is the job.
You'll work alongside our prescribing physicians from first titration through maintenance. All consultations are online.
What You'll Do
 - Conduct nutrition assessments and build individualized care plans via teleconsultation; adjust at every dose escalation.
 - Set and monitor protein targets to protect muscle and bone during rapid weight loss, and watch for micronutrient deficiency risk (vitamin D, calcium, B12, iron). Endorse supplementation or labs to the physician as indicated.
 - Build plans around how Filipinos actually eat — rice as the dietary center, affordable local proteins (isda, manok, itlog, tokwa, monggo), merienda patterns, and handaan. 
 - Manage GI side effects — nausea, vomiting, constipation, LBM, reflux, early satiety — by adjusting meal timing, texture, volume, and fiber. Escalate red flags to the physician immediately.
 - Prepare patients nutritionally for dose reductions and discontinuation driven by cost, supply, or HMO denial, well before they happen.
 - Reinforce cold-chain storage (2–8°C) during brownouts and travel. Escalate immediately if a patient reports sourcing from unregistered sellers.
 - Use motivational interviewing to build habits that hold post-medication; screen for disordered eating and refer out.
 - Use the camera deliberately — ref and pantry walkthroughs, label reading, portions on the patient's own plates. Manage asynchronous follow-up between consults.
 - Document in the EMR and practice per DOH telemedicine guidelines and the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) — approved platforms only.

This role establishes and maintains the Company’s HR governance and compliance framework, ensuring adherence to labor laws, internal policies, and contractual risk standards.
The role serves as the organization’s subject matter expert in labor compliance and employee relations, while conducting structured risk reviews of commercial contracts to protect the Company from legal, financial, and reputational exposure. It functions as a risk control and compliance gatekeeper, working closely with Legal, Finance, and relevant business units to ensure appropriate safeguards are in place before execution.
Main Responsibilities: 
1. Labor Law Compliance & HR Governance
 - Interpret and apply Philippine labor laws, DOLE issuances, and related regulations.

 - Develop, review, and update HR policies and governance guidelines.
 - Ensure policies are legally compliant, clear, and enforceable.
 - Provide guidance on policy interpretation in complex or sensitive cases.
 - Maintain policy version control and governance documentation.
5. Management Advisory & Risk Consultation
 - Advise Management on labor law implications of HR decisions, employee discipline and termination risks, high-risk employee relations matters, contractual risks in influencer/KOL engagements, and complex policy interpretation.
 - Partner with Legal, Finance, HR, and business units on employment and contract-related risk matters.
6. Capability Building & Risk Awareness
